{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check how many rows have biomarker_baseline == -999
print(f'Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check sample_seq distribution to confirm re-testing
print(f'Unique sample_seq values: {df["sample_seq"].unique()}')
print(f'Patient with highest sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max().value_counts()}')"}
